SECTOR
With more than 90 years of work experience in boring and milling machines and machining centres, PAMA is the ideal partner for companies who operate in sectors that require high precision, optimal performance and maximum reliability.
PAMA is an Italian machine tool manufacturer : it does not simply offer a product but guarantees know-how and expert technicians and is specialised in various areas of expertise.
With almost a century of experience and a research & development department that constantly studies and works on new technologies, PAMA develops and manufactures Italian machine tools - boring machines, milling machines and machining centres - for various sectors, guaranteeing quality and reliability.
PAMA offers products tested and developed for the processing of hard materials such as titanium, Inconel and steel alloys, the main applications found in the aerospace sector .
